title: Portrait and Ledger
author: O. M. Sterling
blurb: Rafael Pemberton, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
